# cloudxino Provider

Manage CloudXino resources: CC2 servers, Cloud Firewalls, load balancers, reserved IPs, Kubernetes (CKS) clusters, DNS and SSH keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cloudxino = {
      source  = "cloudxino/cloudxino"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# The API key is read from CLOUDXINO_TOKEN when token is left out.
provider "cloudxino" {
  # token = var.cloudxino_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_url` (String) API address. Defaults to CLOUDXINO_API_URL, else https://cloudxino.com/api.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API key (Account → API keys in the console). Defaults to the CLOUDXINO_TOKEN environment variable.
